rows.title: Effect modification of prenatal folic acid supplementation on the associations of pre-pregnancy BMI and gestational weight gain with offspring birth weight: a large prospective cohort study.
rows.focus: Prospective cohort analysis of 192,596 mother-infant pairs found prenatal folic acid supplementation was modestly associated with lower macrosomia risk and may modify associations between pre-pregnancy BMI and birth weight; observational design limits causal inference.

rows.title: High prevalence of magnesium supplementation during pregnancy: results from the LIFE Child study.
rows.focus: Prospective observational LIFE Child cohort (n=1,078) found magnesium supplementation during pregnancy was common and associated with age, socioeconomic status, and premature contractions; supplementation was not associated with pregnancy duration.
